title: mbar Energia - Supervisor de Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 50 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e o biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Manutenção que ficará responsável pela supervisão de toda equipe de manutenção mecânica, através do acompanhamento de cada etapa dos processos existentes, indicadores de desempenho dos colaboradores, compra dos devidos equipamentos a fim de disponibilizar e garantir uma operação funcional confiável em todos os equipamentos da usina.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Assegurar que os processos da manutenção mecânica sejam executados de uma guisa confiável, supervisionando e executando as manutenções programadas e executadas pelos técnicos mecânicos, através do acompanhamento dos processos em questão, com o propósito de estabelecer a excelência do setor em específico;
  • Assegurar que os equipamentos e sobressalentes sejam comprados corretamente, através da especificação técnica, a fim de adquirir devidamente o maquinário que atenderá toda demanda existente;
  • Executar o plano da manutenção mecânica preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual e pela solicitação das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, a fim de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos da planta, qualidade e segurança dos mesmos;

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications. You will cover all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux file systems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself. You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical’s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about, any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Supervisor, Production Sports (Fixed term 1 year)
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your new role

Planejar, coordenar e executar transmissões ao vivo e gravadas (TV linear, streaming e plataformas digitais), garantindo qualidade editorial, operacional e comercial.

Your role accountabilities

  1. Planejamento Editorial e Operacional das Transmissões
    • Planejar o detalhamento das transmissões (pré-jogo, jogo, intervalo, pós-jogo, programas especiais e conteúdos complementares).
    • Montar, atualizar e distribuir o espelho de transmissão (running order), definindo blocos, entradas de VT, participações, quadros, ações de marca, chamadas e integrações com digital.
    • Articular com técnica, Comercial, Marketing, Digital e parceiros externos para alinhar necessidades, horários, janelas e fluxos.
  2. Coordenação de Equipe e Fluxo “On Air”
    • Atuar como ponto focal entre direção de TV, operação técnica, master, estúdio, talentos (apresentadores, comentaristas, repórteres) e equipe de digital/social.
    • Distribuir tarefas para o time envolvido na transmissão, garantindo que todos tenham briefing claro de pauta, formato e entregas comerciais.
    • Durante o ao vivo, ajustar o espelho em tempo real, de acordo com o andamento do jogo/evento, imprevistos técnicos, demandas editoriais ou comerciais.
    • Controlar o tempo de blocos, entradas e saídas de VT, uso de GC, estatísticas, chamadas e quadros especiais.
  3. Produção de Conteúdo e Preparação de Materiais
    • Pesquisar, apurar e organizar informações relevantes sobre os eventos (ficha técnica, escalações, estatísticas, curiosidades, histórico, bastidores).
    • Elaborar e/ou ajustar roteiros, textos, notas, apoiando talentos e direção com conteúdo contextualizado e atualizado.
    • Solicitar e acompanhar a produção de artes, GC, vinhetas, trilhas, bumpers, layouts de estatísticas e demais elementos gráficos necessários.
    • Coordenar com o time de digital os conteúdos que serão aproveitados em redes sociais, cortes, chamadas e interações ao vivo.
    • Participar ativamente de reuniões com outras áreas envolvidas nos eventos.
  4. Gestão de Entregas Comerciais e Branded Content
    • Garantir que todas as entregas comerciais e ativações de marca estejam previstas no espelho (citadas, GC, vinhetas, quadros patrocinados, “golden breaks”, chamadas, integrações com digital etc.).
    • Coordenar a execução dessas entregas no ar, verificando texto, tempo de tela, posição no bloco, identidade visual e adequação à linha editorial.
    • Registrar as entregas realizadas, apoiando o time Comercial na prestação de contas e no pós-venda.
    • Sugerir formatos de ativações que equilibrem qualidade editorial, experiência da audiência e resultado comercial.
  5. Qualidade Editorial, Conformidade e Padrões de Marca
    • Assegurar que a linguagem, o tom e o formato das transmissões estejam alinhados à estratégia da marca e às características de cada plataforma (TV, streaming, YouTube, redes sociais).
    • Garantir o cumprimento de diretrizes de direitos de transmissão, uso de imagem, política das ligas/federações e normas internas da empresa.
    • Apoiar a direção na priorização de pautas, escolha de quadros e ajustes da narrativa ao longo da transmissão.
  6. Pós-Transmissão e Melhoria Contínua
    • Participar e/ou conduzir o debrief das transmissões, identificando acertos, falhas e oportunidades de melhoria.
    • Consolidar relatórios qualitativos e, quando aplicável, quantitativos (execução de entregas, problemas técnicos, feedback de audiência e repercussão digital).
    • Manter histórico de espelhos, roteiros, formatos e boas práticas, servindo como base para evolução dos produtos.

Qualification & Experiencie

  • Experiência em produção e coordenação de transmissões ao vivo, preferencialmente no universo esportivo.
  • Conhecimento de fluxo de TV e streaming: master, ingest, grade, breaks, GC, estúdio, links, retornos, etc.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de espelho/rundown, planilhas e apresentações (Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides ou similares).
  • Noções básicas de métricas de audiência e consumo em plataformas digitais.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de briefings comerciais e orientações de ligas/federações.

Job Description

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.
  • Live the Rules: Treat the Life‑Saving Rules as non‑negotiable principles that guide your daily decisions and routines.
  • Lead by Example: Show your commitment through your actions and inspire others to do the same.
  • Speak Up: Act immediately if you see something unsafe or identify a potential risk. Empower one another to intervene with courage and care.
  • Educate and Share: Continue fostering conversations about the Life‑Saving Rules within your teams, ensuring everyone understands their importance and application.
  • Collaborate: Work together as One Team to make safety a shared responsibility, ensuring no one is left behind.
  • Goals: Focus on and execute your most important goals.
  • Vision: Together we will continue to enhance, grow and transform.

Non‑Negotiables

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.
  • Live the Rules: Treat the Life‑Saving Rules as non‑negotiable principles that guide your daily decisions and routines.
  • Lead by Example: Show your commitment through your actions and inspire others to do the same.
  • Speak Up: Act immediately if you see something unsafe or identify a potential risk. Empower one another to intervene with courage and care.
  • Educate and Share: Continue fostering conversations about the Life‑Saving Rules within your teams, ensuring everyone understands their importance and application.
  • Collaborate: Work together as One Team to make safety a shared responsibility, ensuring no one is left behind.
  • Goals: Focus on and execute your most important goals.
  • Vision: Together we will continue to enhance, grow and transform.

PROJECTS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore projects.
  • Provide key inputs for engineering and planning to be developed.
  • Define and order equipment and installation aids.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Prepare Task Plans with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Review of Subcontractor Pre‑Commissioning procedures.
  • Prepare Readiness review, Constructability, HAZID.
  • Conduct site visits.
  • Prepare Master Equipment List.
  • Procurement of materials and services.
  • Interface with Pre‑Commissioning Subcontractor on deck layouts. Obtain seafastening packages for vessel spreads and interface with installation team.
  • Equipment inventory, preservation and staging for each mobilization.
  • Attend function tests.
  • Mobilize Pre‑Commissioning equipment and vessels to execute work scopes.
  • Arrange the testing and load‑out of Pre‑Commissioning equipment and installation aids.
  • Coordinate the execution of onshore & offshore Pre‑Commissioning work scopes.
  • Coordinate the demobilization of the Pre‑Commissioning equipment, marine spread and the off‑hire of subcontract equipment.
  • Work at site (onshore and offshore) as required by the project.
  • Prepare MOC's with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Compile and issue Site Memo’s and maintain system completion plan.
  • Compile and present return of experience and lesson learned documents.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Work with the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority to align on Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies.
  • Preparation of subcontractor scopes of works.
  • Manage Pre‑Commissioning subcontracts.
  • Daily Progress Reporting.

TENDERS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority in preparation of technical and commercial build‑ups following the Tendering work instruction.
  • Liaise with installation team during tender phase to ensure alignment on methodologies.
  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore tenders.
  • Engineering and planning for the timely execution of the work scope.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Reviewing of internal and external deliverables (specifications, standards, drawings, reports, procedures, risk assessments, scopes of work, subcontracts).
  • Prepare installation aids requirements.
  • Prepare subcontractor/vendor scopes of works and subsequent technical bid clarification.
  • Prepare pre‑commissioning method statements where required.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Attend site visits where applicable.
  • Technical bid clarification.
  • Provide input into Technical Bid Evaluation process.

Interfaces

The Senior Field Engineer will maintain strong interfaces with the various disciplines within the business line. The main interfaces for Pre‑Commissioning are:

  • Marine Operations Engineers
  • Engineering
  • SCM
  • QHSES
  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers
  • Marine Construction Manager
  • Tender Manager

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7 plus years of experience in the oil and gas industry working for major Contractors.
  • Experience managing a team of more than 2 Engineers.
  • The following experience is required:
    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
    • Rigid & flexible pipeline Pre‑Commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 8 projects.
    • Umbilical pre‑commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 4 projects.

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

  • Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;

  • Postura acolhedora, empática e proativa;

  • Capacidade de lidar com situações delicadas com sensibilidade e discrição.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.
    • Identifies and addresses systemic workflow gaps, documentation risks, and handoff failures to ensure audit-ready operations.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Management: Ability to supervise, train, and develop pre-award staff; set priorities; redistribute work during absences; and maintain team stability in a high-volume environment.
  • Expertise in Federal Funding & Compliance: Deep knowledge of NIH, NSF, DoD, and foundation grants, including federal compliance regulations.
  • Proposal Development & Strategy: Strong understanding of sponsor priorities, funding trends, and proposal submission requirements.
  • Operational Process Design: Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.
  • Data Analytics & Process Improvement: Ability to track, analyze, and optimize pre-award workflows and research funding success rates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Skilled in collaborating with faculty, administrators, legal, compliance, and external sponsors to facilitate research success.
  • Contract & Agreement Oversight: Ability to review and sign standard proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, with the judgment to elevate complex cases appropriately.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Extensive experience in grant and contract administration is essential and will carry more weight than advanced credentials.
  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire lifecycle of research award administration, from the proposal phase to the award set-up.
  • Experience with outgoing subaward and consultant agreement administration, including subrecipient monitoring and risk documentation.
  • Must possess a deep understanding of federal contract requirements.
  • Comprehensive grasp of federal research compliance regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Proficiency with enterprise research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday, or similar platforms).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $145,454 - $160,000

Buscamos um profissional que queira participar ativamente da nossa expansão, mas que também preze pela excelência na gestão do que já construímos! Além do foco em M&A, esperamos alguém que garanta a solidez da nossa estrutura, cuidando do nosso dia a dia societário, registros de marcas e contratos imobiliários estratégicos. Procuramos um perfil que não apenas aponte riscos, mas que ajude a construir soluções e mantenha nossa casa em ordem enquanto crescemos.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar frentes de M&A: Conduzir internamente ou supervisionar via escritórios parceiros todos os atos das operações de aquisição, desde a auditoria (due diligence) até o fechamento e integração pós-aquisição.

  • Graduação completa em direito e formação de no mínimo 5 anos.

title: Geosupport Lead
description:
Overview

Welcome to PXGEO PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

Role Official company title is Technical Lead - Geophysics. We are seeking an experienced Geophysicist to provide technical geophysical support across the Company's Sales & Marketing, Operations, and Engineering Development teams. This role plays a critical part in ensuring exceptional data quality throughout the full project lifecycle and will be responsible for data quality assurance from the initial receipt of tenders through to the delivery of final survey products to the Client. This position requires close collaboration with internal departments to ensure surveys meet technical, commercial, and client expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Support for Sales
    • Provide alternative and/or additional survey designs or layouts to more efficiently meet clients\' geophysical objectives
    • Review incoming data acquisition tender requests and provide technical responses, including technical exceptions, survey area maps, shooting plan scenarios and source modelling
    • Complete project time and motion estimations where required
  • Support for Marketing
    • Contribute to the technical standing of the company through publications at industry conferences and in industry journals
    • Assist in the development of the company Geophysical Initiatives
    • Attend Client Meetings as required. As an expert, participate in meetings and contribute actively to development of client relations and participate in the promotion of the company\'s image of excellence
    • Compile and present geophysical and technical slides, and present Company geophysical initiatives
  • Support for Operations
    • Prepare project start-up documentation including preplots, shooting plans, operational maps, and parameter sheets as appropriate for the seismic method
    • Attend seismic project kick-off, start-up and close-out meetings if required to represent Geophysical Services and Technology group
    • Review end of job report for accuracy and quality
    • Problem dataset analysis with appropriate reporting
    • Assist in the design, writing and implementation of procedures, methods and technical content that facilitate good survey practices and the safe and effective operations of the Geophysical Department. Contribute to continual improvement and review of working practices and standards
    • Propose and implement best practices, new technologies and methodologies in QC processing offshore and geophysical support onshore
    • Ensure the geophysical quality of projects by assisting offshore QC Geophysicists to optimize sequences and parameters, contribute to the test and QC plan adapted to the project
    • Monitor Geophysical-related downtime and inform Management of potential means to reduce downtime
    • Review detailed analysis and provide recommendations on a weekly basis for ongoing projects. Recommendations should contain the following:
      • Acquired data quality Vessel performance
      • Coverage and Infill
    • Monitor the health of the deployed receiver spread
    • Provide support for and where necessary supervision of any production processing efforts for the project whether carried out onboard or by the third party onshore
  • Support for Engineering Development
    • Provide geophysical input into the research and development portfolio
    • In cooperation with Engineering Development, conduct technical studies and tests in order to validate new technologies and methodologies
    • Assist in planning, execution and analysis of acquisition technology tests
    • Develop and design source and receiver configurations
  • General
    • Keep abreast of changes in seismic data acquisition and processing technology
    • Administration of the Company seismic project documentation sharing portal and maintain all ITT & Project location history
    • Ensure department\'s assets are tracked and maintained according to Company procedures and best practices
    • Maintain the necessary software toolbox

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Geophysics, Geoscience, Physics, or a related discipline
  • At least 5+ years of extensive experience in geophysical operations including seismic acquisition and QC, within onshore and offshore environments
  • Exposure to marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to all aspects of seismic surveys with a focus on geophysical method, and processing
  • In-depth knowledge of modern geophysical acquisition technologies and a solid understanding of emerging processing methods and their impact on acquisition design
  • Experience managing geophysical service providers and key technical suppliers
  • Solid understanding of EHSQ principles, compliance with management systems, and delivery of high-quality services
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to act as the primary technical interface for Operations

title: CFD Engineer, Sustainability
description:
Overview

Job Description The Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) engineer belongs to the Global Sustainability Team focusing on ship energy and operational efficiency. As a Sustainability team engineer, you will contribute to the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. The CFD engineer is expected to interact with multiple parts of the organization, taking a lead role in driving the ABS Global Sustainability Advisory CFD services related to the hydrodynamic and aerodynamic performance of a vessel. The role requires involvement in international projects and supporting clients to improve the overall environmental performance of their vessels. Our Risk Management team in Brazil supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen.

What You Will Do

  • Execute CFD services to marine clients related to hull and propeller modification, hydrodynamic and aerodynamic energy efficiency technologies, trim optimization, and performance.
  • Contribute to studies that influence important engineering and operational decisions, while also helping shape the next generation of technical capability within the team.
  • Lead or support a variety of technical safety and risk studies, including: Fire and explosion modelling, Flame detector allocation, Exhaust and ventilation dispersion, Smoke and gas dispersion, Flare radiation analysis, Helideck turbulence studies and Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Be a focal point of contact for CFD-related services in ABS Global Sustainability: Interact with clients to identify/resolve problems in technical expertise.
  • Maintain and improve ABS numerical calculation tools concerning the CFD services.
  • Manage client projects related to CFD: Take the lead in projects related to vessel performance CFD services.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate team members to ensure client needs are met.
  • Develop numerical analysis-based services and products.
  • Contribute to the development of tools and services for ABS Global Sustainability.
  • Initiate and participate in joint development/industry projects with clients or OEMs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of national and international regulatory developments with environmental protection and update the Global Sustainability team accordingly. May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Conduct seminars and workshops as requested.
  • Stay updated on emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. Collaboration and Partnership

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend - Core Services
description:
About The Team

The Core Services Team builds and maintains the mission‑critical, high‑throughput, and fault‑tolerant foundational services that power the entire Uber platform. This includes global‑scale services for Safety, Identity, Payments, and other core business logic.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who operates with a broad scope, influencing the technical direction not just within your team but across multiple dependent platform and product teams. You will drive the design and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems, setting a high bar for engineering excellence and mentoring senior engineers across the organization.

  • Lead the design and architecture of large‑scale, resilient backend services and distributed systems for core platform components (e.g., ensuring high availability, sub‑millisecond latency, and strict data consistency).
  • Own complex backend technical initiatives that impact major product areas or multiple infrastructure and cross‑platform engineering teams.
  • Drive technical decision‑making and establish architectural standards and patterns for the wider Core Services organization, focusing on scalability, security, and multi‑region fault tolerance.
  • Implement critical, high‑performance backend features and microservices using modern languages (e.g., Go, Java) and infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Cassandra, Redis), ensuring they are secure and maintainable.
  • Champion a culture of operational excellence by establishing best practices for observability, proactive monitoring, automated load testing, and incident response.
  • Aggressively identify and resolve systemic technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and non‑performant queries/logic across foundational backend systems.
  • Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to define technical roadmaps that align with long‑term business strategy, specifically regarding the evolution of our core service APIs and data models.
  • Represent the team and its technical strategy in cross‑organizational forums and drive consensus on complex technical tradeoffs between feature velocity, system stability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Act as a force multiplier by mentoring other backend engineers, elevating the technical capabilities and "systems thinking" of the entire organization.
  • Provide in‑depth, rigorous feedback in design and code reviews for critical systems, emphasizing distributed systems best practices, concurrency safety, and resource efficiency.
  • Contribute to the engineering culture by championing best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security‑first development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience in designing, building, and operating large‑scale, high‑availability distributed systems in a production environment.
  • Deep expertise in Backend Infrastructure: Strong mastery of microservices architecture, distributed databases, caching strategies, and asynchronous messaging systems.
  • Proven Leadership: Ability to lead multi‑quarter projects, break down ambiguous technical problems, and drive complex initiatives to successful completion across team boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • SRE Principles: Deep experience with site reliability engineering, including error budgeting, SLO/SLA definition, and building self‑healing systems.
  • Influence: A track record of influencing backend engineering strategy and architecture across different organizational boundaries and functional areas.
